title.zh: Kalshi wants 24/7 Tesla and Nvidia perps as Wall Street fights over who regulates them

current_state.zh: Kalshi is seeking to launch 24/7 perpetual futures tied to Tesla and Nvidia stock prices, intensifying a regulatory turf war between US agencies over which body has jurisdiction over such products.
